verdict.rationale: Salv Cases lets a team open a case, attach alerts, customers and transactions, and work it with an assignee and a status. Cases also appear on every linked record. That covers the assignment half of the story. Nothing in the evidence describes configurable analyst-review or escalation stages, or routing between them. missing for 10: documented multi-stage review/escalation workflow, stage-based routing or reassignment rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
